anchors.name: Upper Mottled Terrain
anchors.description: Mottled terrain covers much of this end of the nucleus. It may be older surface material altered by sublimation.
anchors.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

anchors.name: Central Mesas
anchors.description: Flat-topped mesas rise above the surrounding smooth terrain. Their slopes may expose volatile-rich material.
anchors.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

anchors.name: Central Smooth Terrain
anchors.description: Smooth terrain lies below the central mesas and may collect debris falling from them.
anchors.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

anchors.name: Lower Mottled Terrain
anchors.description: Mottled terrain covers much of the smaller lobe. Sublimation and collapse may have helped produce its rough texture.
anchors.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly
